summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing topline results from its Phase 3 EXPAND study of LIVMARLI (maralixibat) in ultra-rare cholestatic liver diseases, including biliary atresia. The study met its primary endpoint and all five prespecified secondary endpoints; maralixibat showed a 0.98-point placebo-adjusted improvement in pruritus (p=0.0004) and a 69.0% treatment effect on serum bile acids (p≤0.0001). No new safety signals emerged. The company plans a supplemental New Drug Application in the U.S. in the first half of 2027. This is a routine clinical data disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are involved.
